acAnalysis.acText: A unique Standard Purchase Order number is generated and displayed upon successful order submission.
acAnalysis.sapActualBehavior: SAP shows role=alert: 'Purchase order has been created.' — PO number IS generated but NOT displayed in the success notification
acAnalysis.violationDescription: The AC requires the PO number to be 'displayed' in the success confirmation. SAP displays a generic alert without the PO number. The PO number only appears in the document heading when the user navigates to the PO — it is not shown in any explicit success notification.

classificationReason: Re-execution (Phase 3a MCP, headed mode) confirmed: SAP processes the PO creation successfully (PO is created in the system) but the success notification does not contain the 10-digit PO number. This violates the 'displayed' requirement of AC-6. The failure is in SAP application behavior, not in the automation script assertion.

duplicateDefectCheck.existingBugSummary: [MM] TC-CS-021: PO success notification does not display generated PO number — AC-6 violated
duplicateDefectCheck.action: SKIP_CREATION — defect CS-6 already exists and is linked to CS-2
